@graph.comment: Read-only Memento (RFC 7089) HTTP handler. Sits ahead of LdpHandler in the BaseHttpHandler waterfall; claims GETs with Accept-Datetime / ?ext=timemap / ?version= and falls through (NotImplementedHttpError) otherwise.

Insert MementoHttpHandler, WikiSearchHttpHandler, and the two view-layer handlers (ViewHttpHandler + ViewSpaceHttpHandler) immediately before LdpHandler so Memento-shaped, search-grep, and ?_profile= / /vault/views/ requests get claimed before standard LDP processing. ALL four insertions are in this single Override to satisfy the K1 one-Override-per-instance constraint — the view-layer handler INSTANCES are declared in view-layer.json but their insertion steps live here (the same memento.json ↔ wiki-search.json split). Order does not matter: every handler falls through cleanly (NotImplementedHttpError) when its QSA/path is absent.

Per RFC 7089 §4.1.1, the OriginalResource must advertise its TimeMap and TimeGate via Link headers on every response, plus Vary: accept-datetime. This writer runs alongside the default LinkRelMetadataWriter; CSS's addHeader accumulates so both contribute to the final Link header. NOTE: WorkerParallelInitializer override moved to markdown-projection.json (both listeners must be in one place).

Per D86: emits Link: rel="profile" headers, one per dct:conformsTo value on the resource's RepresentationMetadata. Substrate-level kinds (shapes, ontologies, profiles, affordances) AND content-level (wiki:*Profile) handled by one writer. Consolidated here to avoid multiple Override conflicts on MetadataWriter.

Per D112 §5: emits Link: rel="<mem:hasOpenAction IRI>" headers, one per mem:hasOpenAction back-pointer on the resource's RepresentationMetadata. RFC 8288 extension relation = the predicate IRI. Makes open curation proposals visible in-band on GET — the read-path surfacing seam.

Insert MementoLinkMetadataWriter after the default LinkRelMetadataWriter so existing Link rels (ldp:constrainedBy etc) get serialized first; we append on top. Then insert ProfileLinkMetadataWriter after that, CurationLinkMetadataWriter after that, then WikiSearchLinkMetadataWriter last (four steps in one Override).
